listing.title: My First Toys Coloring Book
listing.subtitle: 30 Big & Easy Toy Pages – Teddy Bear, Blocks, Toy Train, Robot & More for Kids Ages 2-5
listing.author: JONNY COLOR
listing.description_html:
Big, bold and easy to color: a first coloring book full of favorite toys!

Little hands color 30 friendly toys, from a cuddly teddy bear and a bouncy ball to a toy train, a robot and a jack-in-the-box. Every page has one big, simple picture with extra-thick lines, so small hands can color inside the lines.

Inside you'll find:

  • Toys to cuddle and play with: Teddy Bear, Doll, Rubber Duck, Ball, Blocks, Puzzle, Yo-Yo, Spinning Top, Jack-in-the-Box, Stacking Rings, Rattle, Balloon, Bubbles, Pinwheel, Kite, a Robot and a Toy Box
  • Toys that go: Toy Car, Toy Train, Toy Boat, Toy Plane, Toy Rocket, Rocking Horse, Scooter and Tricycle
  • Toys for music, art and outdoors: Drum, Xylophone, Crayons, Jump Rope and Pail & Shovel
  • One large picture per page with thick outlines, and each name in big letters to color
  • Single-sided pages with a blank back, so markers won't bleed onto the next picture
  • Big 8.5 x 11 inch pages and a "Great job!" certificate at the end

A fun, screen-free activity for toddlers and preschoolers ages 2 to 5.

Part of the my first step series. Also try My First Dinosaurs Coloring Book and My First Animals Coloring Book.
